subject.summary: One run of NetLogo's Virus on a Network. The network on the floor; each turtle rises to the tick its infected? first turned true, and each link between two risen turtles climbs from the earlier to the later.

sources.title: A construct of a NetLogo run

facts.value: Y is up. The floor is the NetLogo world, 10 m across its longer side; height is time, 6 m from tick 0 to tick 972, as the square root of the tick.
peak: 118 turtles with infected? true at tick 68

how: The floor is the network as NetLogo laid it out.
Each turtle rises to the tick its infected? first turned true; one left on the floor never turned.
A link climbs from the earlier of its two turtles to the later: a steep climb joins two turtles that turned far apart in time (the link need not be the way it spread).
Height is time, tick 0 to 972, as its square root, so the early spread is stretched.
